g.text: Every map, both tails, on the same slices
Red fill: signed RPE, positive · outlines: uRPE (green) and surprise (blue) · solid = positive tail, dashed = negative
Surprise has no surviving negative clusters at any threshold tested. The dashed green outlines are uRPE
going negative — they fall inside the red map, while the solid green ones sit outside it.
